summary: Frontend-only validation of 5 new SystemHealth Evidence Locker admin features + regression. All 7 requested flows PASS: (1) Login + evidence panel renders, no runtime errors. (2) Custom Report Period generate: month (August 2026) added new row with 'August 2026' subtitle + toast 'Evidence archived to locker · August 2026'; quarter (Q3 2026) also generated with 'Q3 2026' label + matching toast. (3) Retention keep changed 60->45, toast 'Retention updated · Keeping the latest 45 report(s)' shown, persisted across reload (backend GET /deploy/evidence-config). (4) Share modal opens with public URL '/api/deploy/evidence/shared/<token>', Copy + Close work. (5) Verify link href points to '/api/deploy/evidence/verify/<token>' as expected. (6) Digest preview shows 'All systems healthy — no digest would be sent today' and sh-digest-send correctly absent while healthy. (7) Regression: monthly checkbox toggles with toast; verify/share/download buttons render on each row; Restore Preview Log panel renders with entries. Left monthly toggle ON as instructed.
seed_data_creation: Generated 2 extra evidence PDFs (August 2026 month + Q3 2026 quarter) via the UI; retention (keep=45) will auto-prune older ones as expected.
